RCC eNewsletter
September 2021
Two Fall Workshops Coming Up
We're pleased to announce the return of in-person RCC workshops this Fall. We are collaborating with FSU Libraries to bring the FSU Research community hands-on experience with RCC technologies. The remaining workshops are:

  *   Sept 28 - Intro to Python on the HPC<https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://cl.s11.exct.net/?qs=d1bdb77f256915e4f552f362dc586c108c57f3b19fb7e4bb14348c09e8e256ca7aab04b31c008631565d07a175e98056e36dc93d3c853214__;!!PhOWcWs!jz6zEvg1DzlXkAdcp3GWMXwRu1L74zwqMS4OROqcF9k3sNf6m4aC2IOF-vgEiLk$>
  *   Oct 19 - Intro to "R"<https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://cl.s11.exct.net/?qs=97a4a5bf50a040998cc588dd5ab7c7000199d603b20d4a6d79b43a4dea16fd751b2e0827567681319e1be05c922420fddec027e6f384ad2f__;!!PhOWcWs!jz6zEvg1DzlXkAdcp3GWMXwRu1L74zwqMS4OROqcF9k3sNf6m4aC2IOFbJOGrHA$>

Sliger Maintenance September Update<https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://cl.s11.exct.net/?qs=86d28f4d4c0b99a20254901e61e4ebc729f4ebd46fd0ec8245993bc5ce5040b476ec2207f1d7a1260bc41d6e7690420f0a42a40db238b600__;!!PhOWcWs!jz6zEvg1DzlXkAdcp3GWMXwRu1L74zwqMS4OROqcF9k3sNf6m4aC2IOFSkQwMeE$>
Construction at the Sliger Data Center is still on-going, but expected to be completed in the Fall. We've been posting images as the renovation progresses.

See images ?<https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://cl.s11.exct.net/?qs=8ff62fa5504a4f8d5f2b490cf358a67c407366c93d90348e79f8c27e3d8df3a7d7bef2a6125c20a3df9cacbb8c87ed06f7537cfa05bcfb05__;!!PhOWcWs!jz6zEvg1DzlXkAdcp3GWMXwRu1L74zwqMS4OROqcF9k3sNf6m4aC2IOFN-7mDFw$>
Research Spotlight: Scott Stagg<https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://cl.s11.exct.net/?qs=fefe0ddcaac888922555d789a699fb5da02ca6c1914e97b22ebc33c89a144eadeca8de1212c86bb8fa21c87555dd78ec3174f674d18e5fd1__;!!PhOWcWs!jz6zEvg1DzlXkAdcp3GWMXwRu1L74zwqMS4OROqcF9k3sNf6m4aC2IOFXr_Xjvw$>
Dr. Scott Stagg, FSU researcher and chemistry/biochemistry professor, uses a special technique called cryo-electron microscopy (CryoEM) to create three-dimensional structures of these molecules to better learn how they make bonds, break bonds, assemble and disassemble.

Read the spotlight ?<https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://cl.s11.exct.net/?qs=16e72e8f43fc42da4f0ddc41e31b03928c24a82647fdb9867a05d098597ae7404706a5bac1f56c4dee77ce5361da9cd4f6fd68d9c5181687__;!!PhOWcWs!jz6zEvg1DzlXkAdcp3GWMXwRu1L74zwqMS4OROqcF9k3sNf6m4aC2IOFAE4JbPc$>
RCC partners with CIMES & Engineering to recycle can rings<https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://cl.s11.exct.net/?qs=3ac2671229d370e4ab3263cee7dc9ea4b6bcff84436780c52749462de94871115ac766aeb077f5ace08a6666fe990f2f4f70506d3f7d5fb5__;!!PhOWcWs!jz6zEvg1DzlXkAdcp3GWMXwRu1L74zwqMS4OROqcF9k3sNf6m4aC2IOF3U5kgZw$>
The Research Computing Center has partnered with the Center for Information Management and Educational Services (CIMES) and FAMU/FSU College of Engineering Resilient Infrastructure & Disaster Response (RIDER) Center to designate the Sliger Building a collection center to recycle can rings that would otherwise be sent to the landfill. This is in collaboration with RingRecycleMe<https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://cl.s11.exct.net/?qs=321a63c19e0fd0a320e2689444ad8c380957916708e6b7caf200622561592986907b92fd903e8d136e1fdc03455f86bb791336ca9016821f__;!!PhOWcWs!jz6zEvg1DzlXkAdcp3GWMXwRu1L74zwqMS4OROqcF9k3sNf6m4aC2IOFcqjtAZc$>, which processes the can rings.

Find out more ?<https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://cl.s11.exct.net/?qs=44379fc5b238572535e2c01d0665c54d90696250096ada3b2fe912b877ef00fd59caffe3c3fc947ef64b985efcdcc86f1cc81e68b3f35544__;!!PhOWcWs!jz6zEvg1DzlXkAdcp3GWMXwRu1L74zwqMS4OROqcF9k3sNf6m4aC2IOFN1es2oY$>
